pli-tv-bu-vb-pc9:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc9:1.2: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā upanando sakyaputto chabbaggiyehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ bhaṇḍanakato hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc9:1.3: so sañcetanikaṃ sukkavissaṭṭhiṃ āpattiṃ āpajjitvā saṅghaṃ tassā āpattiyā parivāsaṃ yāci.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc9:1.4: tassa saṅgho tassā āpattiyā parivāsaṃ adāsi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc9:1.5: tena kho pana samayena sāvatthiyaṃ aññatarassa pūgassa saṅghabhattaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc9:1.8: “eso āvuso āyasmā upanando sakyaputto tumhākaṃ sambhāvito kulūpago yeneva hatthena saddhādeyyaṃ bhuñjati teneva hatthena upakkamitvā asuciṃ mocesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc9:1.9: so sañcetanikaṃ sukkavissaṭṭhiṃ āpattiṃ āpajjitvā saṅghaṃ tassā āpattiyā parivāsaṃ yāci.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc9:1.10: tassa saṅgho tassā āpattiyā parivāsaṃ adāsi .
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc9:1.12: ye te bhikkhū appicchā …pe… te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc9:1.13: “kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū bhikkhussa duṭṭhullaṃ āpattiṃ anupasampannassa ārocessantī”ti …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc9:1.14: saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave bhikkhussa duṭṭhullaṃ āpattiṃ anupasampannassa ārocethāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc9:1.17: kathaṃ hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā bhikkhussa duṭṭhullaṃ āpattiṃ anupasampannassa ārocessatha,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc9:1.19: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc9:1.20.1: “yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhussa duṭṭhullaṃ āpattiṃ anupasampannassa āroceyya aññatra bhikkhusammutiyā pācittiya”nti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc9:2.1.8: cattāri ca pārājikāni, terasa ca saṅghādisesā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc9:2.1.10: bhikkhuñca bhikkhuniñca ṭhapetvā avaseso anupasampanno nāma.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc9:2.1.12: āroceti itthiyā vā purisassa vā gahaṭṭhassa vā pabbajitassa vā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc9:2.1.16: atthi bhikkhusammuti kulapariyantā na āpattipariyantā atthi bhikkhusammuti āpattipariyantā ca kulapariyantā ca, atthi bhikkhu sammuti neva āpattipariyantā na kulapariyantā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc9:2.1.18: āpattiyo pariggahitāyo honti ettakāhi āpattīhi ārocetabboti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc9:2.1.20: kulāni pariggahitāni honti ettakesu kulesu ārocetabboti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc9:2.1.22: āpattiyo ca pariggahitāyo honti kulāni ca pariggahitāni honti ettakāhi āpattīhi ettakesu kulesu ārocetabboti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc9:2.1.24: āpattiyo ca apariggahitāyo honti kulāni ca apariggahitāni honti ettakāhi āpattīhi ettakesu kulesu ārocetabboti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc9:2.1.25.1: āpattipariyante yā āpattiyo pariggahitāyo honti tā āpattiyo ṭhapetvā aññāhi āpattīhi āroceti, āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc9:2.1.26: kulapariyante yāni kulāni pariggahitāni honti tāni kulāni ṭhapetvā aññesu kulesu āroceti āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc9:2.1.27: āpattipariyante ca kulapariyante ca yā āpattiyo pariggahitāyo honti, tā āpattiyo ṭhapetvā yāni kulāni pariggahitāni honti tāni kulāni ṭhapetvā aññāhi āpattīhi aññesu kulesu āroceti āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc9:2.2.1: duṭṭhullāya āpattiyā duṭṭhullāpattisaññī anupasampannassa āroceti, aññatra bhikkhusammutiyā, āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc9:2.2.2: duṭṭhullāya āpattiyā vematiko anupasampannassa āroceti aññatra bhikkhusammutiyā āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc9:2.2.3: duṭṭhullāya āpattiyā aduṭṭhullāpattisaññī anupasampannassa āroceti aññatra bhikkhusammutiyā āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc9:2.2.5: anupasampannassa duṭṭhullaṃ vā aduṭṭhullaṃ vā ajjhācāraṃ āroceti āpatti dukkaṭassa.
